quotes.text: "The primed contacts.onManyCreated event should return the correct values"

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The bulk-created observer drops the known address-book contact cache and emits one parent node. Its persistent event wakes the background and converts that node without requesting complete contacts; consumers must rebuild their own cache. The MV3 test directly checks wakeup and address-book payload, not every new card or remote backend. Keep internal onManyContactsCreated and public contacts.onManyCreated distinct.
title: contacts.onManyCreated invalidates contacts and emits an address-book node
